audit.whatIsWrong: The root combo was written as 'E-Q' — Rune Prison is his W and only roots if Spell Flux (E) tagged you first; without Flux it merely slows. audit.why: Real interactions: Flux (E, 3.5s CD) enables the W root and empowered Q; your Q silence denies the chain; Nether Grasp suppresses his immobile kit; his Realm Warp (180s) vs your R (140/110/80).

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your spell shield (Iron Boundary) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Rune Prison (W): 11s at rank 1 — it only roots if Spell Flux (E, 3.5s) tagged you first, so track the Flux debuff. - His Realm Warp runs 180s; your Nether Grasp is 140/110/80 — your kill window comes up first. - Void Shift has exactly one job: eat the root.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Voidlings plus visions crash the wave while his early Overload is too mana-hungry to match — every crash taxes his Tear stacking and bleeds his tempo.

edits.after: A stacked-mana Ryze with Flux on you deletes half your bar through the root — with Void Shift down you have no answer to the E-W-Q chain.
